initial_sql:
SELECT
    c.id AS customer_id,
    c.name,
    COALESCE(inv.billed, 0) AS billed,
    COALESCE(pay.paid, 0) AS paid
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT customer_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status != 'void' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS billed
    FROM invoices
    GROUP BY customer_id
) inv ON c.id = inv.customer_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT customer_id,
           SUM(amount) AS paid
    FROM payments
    GROUP BY customer_id
) pay ON c.id = pay.customer_id
ORDER BY c.id
